set_no_jit_context: use the set_no_jit context manager to disable JIT optimization for model layers temporarily
set_exportable_context: use the set_exportable context manager to enable ONNX export mode with Same padding
set_scriptable_context: use the set_scriptable context manager to enable torch.jit.script compatibility for a model
set_layer_config_context: use the set_layer_config context manager to set all layer config flags at once
layer_config_kwargs_helper: use layer_config_kwargs to consume config kwargs and return a set_layer_config context manager
